from datetime import timedelta
import math

# Load the workbook
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/mnt/data/spreadsheet/38462/1_38462_init.xlsx')
ws = wb.active

# Inspect the data
# The user wants to round up time formatted as [h]:mm to the nearest whole hour.
# In Excel, time is stored as a fraction of a day.

# Calculation:

# Round up to nearest whole hour.

results = []

    val = ws[f'B{row}'].value

        results.append(rounded_hours)

for i, val in enumerate(results, start=1):
